TP-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products. They are seeking a recent graduate for the role of Early Career Embedded Software Engineer, where the individual will help design, develop, and improve core software for their devices while gaining hands-on experience and mentorship from experienced engineers.

Responsibilities
Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of scalable software systems and products across a range of engineering domains
Build, test, and maintain high-quality code for applications, services, or system-level software
Collaborate on the development of core components, which may include user-facing applications, backend services, or system-level modules (e.g., networking, connectivity, storage, or device integration)
Work with modern development tools, frameworks, and environments
Contribute to testing efforts, including unit, integration, and system-level validation to ensure reliability and performance
Partner with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver effective technical solutions
Learn and apply best practices for performance, scalability, and efficiency across different system layers
Stay curious - explore new technologies and contribute ideas that shape future products

Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and attention to detail
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively
